converting dates to numbers:


```{r}

install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("readr")
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)



coerce_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  out <- suppressWarnings(ymd(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(dmy(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(mdy(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(readr::parse_date(x,
                      locale = locale(date_names = "en")))
  as.Date(out)
}
#cleaning data all across all column

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Traded        = coerce_date(Traded),
    Filed         = coerce_date(Filed),
    last_modified = coerce_date(last_modified)
  )

View(df)
# write_csv(df, "project_clean.csv")
```


Converting trade size usd into intervall


```{r}

parse_value_or_interval <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- gsub("[$,]", "", x)
  if(grepl("-", x_clean)) {  # c'est un intervalle
    parts <- strsplit(x_clean, " - ")[[1]]
    start <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    end <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  } else {  # valeur unique
    start <- as.numeric(x_clean)
    end <- start
  }
  return(c(start = start, end = end))
}

# Parser tout le vecteur
parsed <- t(sapply(df$Trade_Size_USD, parse_value_or_interval))
parsed <- as.data.frame(parsed)

# Intervalles connus (start != end)
known_intervals <- parsed[parsed$start != parsed$end & !is.na(parsed$start) & !is.na(parsed$end), ]

# Fonction robuste pour remplacer valeur unique par intervalle
replace_by_interval <- function(start, end, known_intervals) {
  if(is.na(start) | is.na(end)) {
    return(c(NA, NA))
  }
  
  if(!is.na(start) & start == end) {  # valeur unique
    match <- known_intervals[known_intervals$start <= start & known_intervals$end >= start, ]
    if(nrow(match) > 0) {
      return(c(match$start[1], match$end[1]))
    } else {
      return(c(start, end))
    }
  } else {  # déjà un intervalle
    return(c(start, end))
  }
}

# Appliquer à tout le vecteur
final_intervals <- t(apply(parsed, 1, function(row) replace_by_interval(row["start"], row["end"], known_intervals)))

# Dataframe final
final_df <- data.frame(
  original = df$Trade_Size_USD,
  start = final_intervals[, 1],
  end = final_intervals[, 2]
)

print(final_df)

View(df)

```
